'''Galois Theory''' is a 2004 mathematics textbook by [[David A. Cox]] for undergraduates, on [[Galois theory]]. A revised second edition was published in 2012.

* {{cite journal |last=Giblin |first=Peter |title=Review of ''Galois Theory'' |journal=The Mathematical Gazette |publisher=The Mathematical Association |year=2016 |volume=100 |issue=548 |page=374 |jstor=44161840|doi=10.1017/mag.2016.90 }}
* {{cite journal |last=Gouvêa |first=Fernando Q. |title=Review of ''Galois Theory'' |journal=MAA Reviews |publisher=Mathematical Association of America |year=2012 |url=https://old.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/galois-theory-4}}
* Kleinert, Werner. Reviews of ''Galois Theory''. {{zbl|1057.12002}} and {{zbl|1247.12006}} (separate review of 2nd edition).
